text: Jasmine's driving test is next Tuesday, third attempt. She's properly nervous this time, said she can't sleep. Text her good luck Monday night.
Laura moved to Leeds in the spring, works at the uni library now. Her husband Dmitri is a paramedic.
elif results day thurs - wants to do medicine at kings, needs AAA

Call with Kalani re the Brennan account. Client wants the deck by end of the month, Kalani thinks her manager is going to push it back anyway. Kalani's off sometime next week for her sister's graduation in Wellington.
Ebony passed her theory test!! first go. practical booked for early March

So Mustafa was telling me at lunch that his boss Patrick is retiring over the summer and nobody knows who's taking over. Mustafa's quietly hoping it's him. I should ask how the interview goes, he thinks it'll be in a fortnight.
Uma lives in Cork, two kids, older one is at secondary. Husband is from Ghana originally, Yaw I think.
Dont forget to send Karan the notes from Fridays meeting before he presents to the board
Ben's grade 8 piano exam was yesterday. Ask him how it went, he looked green beforehand.
Need to pick up dry cleaning tomorrow and book the car in for its MOT sometime next week.
Joseph Kowalski, new account manager at the agency. Polish, lives in Manchester, supports City. Has a little girl, about four.
Lin's daughter got into the Royal Ballet School summer intensive. Audition was in the autumn, they only heard this week. Lin's over the moon.

Hiroshi called. His team's restructure got cancelled, so the redundancy meetings that were meant to be next Wednesday aren't happening. Big relief for him, he'd been dreading it for weeks. He's taking the kids to his in-laws in Osaka over half term to celebrate, and his wife is finally going back to work part time from the start of December.
tendai - nursing finals early may. struggling w the placement hours, sounds exhausted. check in end of the month
Yuki's boyfriend Julien proposed! On holiday in Lyon. Wedding probably next summer.

Tanvi and her husband are both doing the Dublin marathon this weekend. Their first one. She's been training since January, he only started in the summer and is convinced he'll have to walk the last ten k. Their kids are making signs. Tanvi says if they both finish they're booking Berlin for next year.
Rosa works in HR at the council. Grew up in Porto, moved here at twelve. Vegetarian, hates coriander.
Hemi is doing his citizenship test Friday and asked if I could quiz him on Thursday evening. I'm going round after work for that.

Aoife from accounts said Erin's leaving at the end of the month, going to a startup in Galway. Leaving drinks probably the Friday before. Should chip in for a card and something nice, Erin mentioned wanting a decent coffee grinder.
Kevin failed his driving test again, the roundabout bit apparently. Rebooked for sometime in December. He's gutted, maybe take him for a pint this weekend.
Vanessa Dubois - goes by Ness. Head of procurement at the client, very blunt, prefers calls to email.

voice memo. ok so just off the phone with Alina, her mum's having a knee op next Thursday and she's going to be off for the rest of the week to look after her. She asked if I could cover the Monday stand up. Also she mentioned her son Hassan has his GCSE mocks starting tomorrow and he's not revised at all, she's tearing her hair out. Remember to ask about the mum on Friday.
Amy said her cat Biscuit has to have a tooth out on Monday. She's a bit worried about the anaesthetic.
Jasmine passed!!! Message her congrats tonight.
James is the new project lead on the Murphy build. Ex army, very by the book. Lives out near Swindon.
Laura's brother Sam is sitting the bar exam in late February. She says he's been revising since the summer.
Elif got her offer, she's going to Kings in September. Buy her something for uni, she said she needs a proper desk lamp.
Kalani's manager Mrs Patel is moving to the Singapore office early next year. Kalani is worried about who she'll get instead.
Note to self: pay the gas bill, renew passport before the summer, sort out the spare room.
Dmitri says he and Laura are thinking of moving back to London. Nothing decided. They both miss their friends down here.
Mustafa got the job! Starts as department head after Easter. Must send a card.

Coffee with Uma and Karan. Uma's starting a part time masters in January, evenings only, in data science, and her company are paying half. Karan's wife is due in March, their second. He's nervous about juggling it with the new client, who apparently rings him at 9pm. Their first, Arjun, starts reception in September too. I should ask Karan sometime next week if he's spoken to his manager about paternity leave.
Ben O'Brien, Hiroshi's partner. Works in theatre lighting. Allergic to nuts. Two dogs, Pepper and Bramble.
Hiroshi's partner Ben has his first big show opening on the 14th, lighting design for a touring production. Book tickets for us maybe the following weekend.
Tendai's little brother has his 11 plus next Saturday. Their mum is more stressed than he is.
quick one - Joseph off tomorrow, daughter starting nursery. ask how she settled in on weds
Interview for the senior role is Thursday at ten. Prep the STAR examples tonight and iron the blue shirt.
Patrick's retirement do got called off, his wife is unwell. Ask after her next time I see him.

Yaw is a software engineer at a bank in Canary Wharf. Lives in Greenwich with Uma's cousin Hemi, they've been together about six years. Big Arsenal fan, has a season ticket. Grew up in Kumasi, came over for his masters. Collects old vinyl, mostly highlife. Doesn't drink.

Talked to Yuki for ages on the train. She's a primary teacher, Year 2, at a school in Hackney. Her mum lives with them since her dad died a couple of years ago. Yuki says she's thinking about doing her headship qualification eventually but not this year.
Tanvi finished in 4:12! Julien was waiting at the finish line with a sign. Remind me to send them both a congrats message.

Rosa's daughter Ebony has her driving test in a fortnight and Rosa is a wreck about it, Ebony's totally relaxed. Ebony's already planning a road trip to Cornwall with her mates over the summer, which isn't helping Rosa's nerves. Rosa's husband has been taking her out every evening. Ebony starts at Exeter in September, studying marine biology.
Erin's last day is Friday. Card's signed. Present is sorted, the grinder.
Hemi passed his citizenship test, ceremony sometime in the new year. He wants to throw a party after.
Aoife Murphy - Erin's replacement starting Monday. Came from a competitor. Seems sharp, a bit shy. Lives in Dun Laoghaire.
Kevin's driving test moved up to next Friday, someone cancelled. Text him good luck Thursday night and maybe offer a practice run this weekend.

Ness from procurement said the contract renewal meeting is pushed to early November. Her team is being audited over the summer next year so we need to get everything signed before then. She also hinted their legal team is new and slow. Get Joseph to draft the redlines by Friday and loop in James before the call, he knows the history with their old director.
Alina's mum's op went fine. She's home already, sore but chirpy.

Amy's partner Lin has his PhD viva sometime next week. He's terrified apparently, hasn't slept properly in days. Amy asked us not to mention it at the party on Saturday. Text Lin on the morning of the viva.

Team meeting ran over. James says the client, a Mr Kumar, is threatening to walk if we miss the January deadline. Jasmine from design is already doing weekends and looked shattered, her mum's been in and out of hospital too. Patrick wants a revised timeline by Wednesday. Need to talk to James about getting a contractor in, and take Jasmine for lunch this week to see how she's actually doing.
Laura says the uni is closing her library branch in the summer. She might get redeployed or might not. She's trying not to think about it. Check in with her end of next month.
Gym at 7 tomorrow, then dentist at 11. Groceries after.
Elif's twin Alice is retaking her chemistry A level in June, missed the grade by two marks. Alice's quietly gutted but won't say so.
Dmitri's paramedic exams are this weekend, the advanced practice ones. Then they're off to Crete for a week.
Karan's wife had the baby early, a girl, Mira. Both doing well. Organise a collection at work.
Mustafa's mum turns 70 at the end of the month and he's throwing a surprise dinner on the Saturday. I'm doing the cake.
Kalani Mensah, client side at Brennan. Calls herself Kal. Born in Hawaii, moved to Bristol for uni and stayed. Two teenage boys.
Tendai's results day is mid July. She's convinced she failed the pharmacology paper. I don't think she did.

Long chat with Vanessa after the review. Her boss Julien is leaving at Christmas and she's been asked to act up while they recruit. She's going to apply for it properly but she's not sure she wants the stress, her daughter has her grade 5 violin exam in January and Vanessa's been doing all the practice with her. Ask her early December whether she put in the application.
Nothing much from the call really. Hassan just wanted to vent about the commute.
